product.title: Louvre Museum Priority Access Guided Tour with Mona Lisa

description.text: In Paris, head straight into the home of the Mona Lisa with this skip-the-line tour of the world's largest art museum. Once inside, your local art historian guide will provide you with background about some of the Louvre's most striking masterpieces. Stops include Louvre Pyramid, Louvre Museum. Local commentary and route logistics are handled so you can focus on Paris landmarks, river views, and neighborhood walking or cycling highlights. Ideal for visitors basing in Paris who want a guided city experience without coordinating Metro routes, attraction tickets, or landmark timing on their own. Routes stay oriented to Louvre Pyramid, Louvre Museum that define this Paris sightseeing experience, with a guide handling Metro connections, ticket windows, and neighborhood pacing so the day stays focused on the city rather than logistics.
